ei.title: 4번: A Special Lesson on Dental Health
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to (A)[improve / reduce] the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely (B)[bored / interested] and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with (C)[harmful / useful] items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) improve=향상시키다 / reduce=줄이다 (B) interested=관심 있는 / bored=지루해하는 (C) useful=유용한 / harmful=해로운
det.analysis:
① improve—interested—useful: 방문 목적은 이해를 '향상'시키는 것 + 학생들이 매우 '관심 있어' 함 + '유용한' 물건이 든 선물 가방 ←정답
② reduce/harmful: 줄이다/해로운은 문맥과 반대
③ bored: 지루해했다면 질문을 많이 하지 않았을 것 — 문맥 반대
④ reduce/bored/harmful: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 이해를 향상(improve)시키고, 관심 있어(interested) 하며, 유용한(useful) 물건을 받는 흐름

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students (A)[welcomed / ignored] Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having (B)[began / completed] the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take (C)[worse / better] care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) welcomed=맞이했다 / ignored=무시했다 (B) completed=끝마쳤다 / began=시작했다 (C) better=더 잘 / worse=더 나쁘게
det.analysis:
① ignored: 학생들이 치과의사를 '무시'했다? 초청해 맞이했으므로 부적절
② began/worse: 체험을 '시작'만 하고 선물을 받았다? '더 나쁘게' 관리? 문맥 반대
③ welcomed—completed—better: 치과의사를 '맞이'하고, 체험을 '끝마친' 뒤 선물을 받아, 이를 '더 잘' 관리 ←정답
④ ignored/began/worse: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 치과의사를 맞이(welcomed)하고, 체험을 끝마친(completed) 뒤, 치아를 더 잘(better) 관리

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag (A)[filled / empty] with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and (B)[sick / healthy]. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice (C)[careless / proper] dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) filled=가득 찬 / empty=텅 빈 (B) healthy=건강한 / sick=아픈 (C) proper=올바른 / careless=부주의한
det.analysis:
① empty: 유용한 물건으로 '텅 빈' 가방? 모순 — 부적절
② filled—healthy—proper: 유용한 물건으로 '가득 찬' 가방 + 치아를 깨끗하고 '건강하게' + 집에서 '올바른' 관리 실천 ←정답
③ sick/careless: 아픈/부주의한은 문맥 반대
④ empty/sick/careless: 모두 문맥 반대
det.tip: 가득 찬(filled) 선물 가방, 건강한(healthy) 치아, 올바른(proper) 관리 흐름

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a ①<u>local</u> dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely ②<u>bored</u> and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with ③<u>useful</u> items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice ④<u>proper</u> dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① local=지역의 ② interested→bored (부적절) ③ useful=유용한 ④ proper=올바른
det.analysis:
① local: 근처 병원에서 온 '지역' 치과의사 — 적절
② bored: 학생들이 '지루해'했다면 질문을 많이 하지 않았을 것. 매우 관심 있어(interested) 했다가 원문 ←정답
③ useful: 유용한 물건이 든 선물 가방 — 적절
④ proper: 올바른 치아 관리를 실천하도록 — 적절
det.tip: 질문을 많이 했으므로 흥미로워(interested)한 것. bored(지루한)는 정반대

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students ①<u>welcomed</u> Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to ②<u>improve</u> the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having ③<u>completed</u> the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take ④<u>worse</u> care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① welcomed=맞이했다 ② improve=향상시키다 ③ completed=끝마쳤다 ④ better→worse (부적절)
det.analysis:
① welcomed: 학생들이 치과의사를 맞이함 — 적절
② improve: 방문 목적은 이해를 향상시키는 것 — 적절
③ completed: 체험을 끝마친 뒤 선물을 받음 — 적절
④ worse: 치아를 전보다 '더 나쁘게' 관리한다? 특별 수업 후이므로 better(더 잘)가 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 수업 덕분에 치아를 더 잘(better) 관리. worse(더 나쁘게)는 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① importance=중요성 ② extremely=매우 ③ healthy=건강한 ④ proper→careless (부적절)
det.analysis:
① importance: 치아 건강의 '중요성'에 대한 이해 — 적절
② extremely: 학생들이 '매우' 관심 있어 함 — 적절
③ healthy: 치아를 깨끗하고 '건강하게' 유지 — 적절
④ careless: 집에서 '부주의한' 관리를 실천하라고 격려? 올바른(proper) 관리가 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 집에서 올바른(proper) 치아 관리를 실천. careless(부주의한)는 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: barely=거의 ~않다 / slightly=약간 / extremely=극도로, 매우 / rarely=드물게
det.analysis:
① barely: 거의 관심이 없었다면 질문을 많이 하지 않았을 것 — 부적절
② slightly: 약간만 관심? 질문을 많이 한 것과 안 맞음
③ extremely: 매우 관심 있어 해서 치과의사에게 많은 질문을 함 ←정답
④ rarely: 드물게? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 질문을 많이 한 것 = 매우(extremely) 관심 있었다는 근거

det.analysis:

② useful: 치아를 깨끗하고 건강하게 유지하는 데 '유용한' 물건이 든 선물 가방 ←정답
③ empty: '텅 빈' 물건? 문맥 부적절
④ noisy: '시끄러운' 물건? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 치아 관리에 도움이 되는 = 유용한(useful) 물건

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 nearby와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: nearby=가까이에 / far away=멀리 / close by=가까이에 / across the sea=바다 건너 / underground=지하에
det.analysis:
① far away: 멀리 — nearby와 반대
② close by: 가까이에 — nearby의 동의어 ←정답
③ across the sea: 바다 건너 — 의미 다름
④ underground: 지하에 — 의미 다름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 completed와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: completed=끝마쳤다 / started=시작했다 / canceled=취소했다 / delayed=미뤘다 / finished=끝냈다
det.analysis:
① started: 시작했다 — completed와 반대
② canceled: 취소했다 — 의미 다름
③ delayed: 미뤘다 — 의미 다름
④ finished: 끝냈다 — completed의 동의어 ←정답
det.tip: 체험을 끝마친(completed) = finished(끝낸)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 proper와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: proper=올바른, 적절한 / wrong=틀린 / correct=올바른 / rare=드문 / cheap=값싼
det.analysis:

② correct: 올바른 — proper의 동의어 ←정답
③ rare: 드문 — 의미 다름
④ cheap: 값싼 — 의미 다름
det.tip: 올바른(proper) 치아 관리 = correct(올바른) 관리

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 clean과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: clean=깨끗한 / dirty=더러운 / fresh=신선한 / pure=순수한 / bright=밝은
det.analysis:
① dirty: 더러운 — clean의 반의어 ←정답
② fresh: 신선한 — clean과 비슷한 축, 반의어 아님
③ pure: 순수한 — clean과 비슷한 축, 반의어 아님
④ bright: 밝은 — 의미 다름
det.tip: 깨끗한(clean)의 반대는 dirty(더러운). fresh·pure는 유사어라 오답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 better과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: better=더 나은 / worse=더 나쁜 / greater=더 큰 / further=더 먼 / larger=더 큰
det.analysis:
① worse: 더 나쁜 — better의 반의어 ←정답
② greater: 더 큰 — 크기의 축, 반의어 아님
③ further: 더 먼 — 거리의 축, 의미 다름
④ larger: 더 큰 — 크기의 축, 반의어 아님
det.tip: 더 나은(better)의 반대는 worse(더 나쁜). greater·larger는 크기라 오답

questions.passage:
(A) The young pianist needs to <u>practice</u> the same difficult song for many hours every single day.

(B) The dentist encouraged the students to <u>practice</u> proper dental care at home, such as brushing twice a day.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 practice의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: practice: (A) 연습하다 (B) (습관적으로) 실천하다, 행하다
det.analysis:
① (A) 연습하다 (B) 연습하다: (B) 치아 관리를 '연습'한다는 어색함 — 부적절
② (A) 실천하다 (B) 연습하다: (A) 피아니스트가 곡을 '실천'? 부적절
③ (A) 연습하다 (B) 실천하다: 피아니스트가 곡을 '연습하다' + 학생들이 올바른 치아 관리를 '실천하다' ←정답
④ (A) 병원 (B) 실천하다: (A) practice가 여기서는 동사라 '병원(명사)'이 아님
det.tip: practice의 다의어: (곡을) 연습하다 vs (습관을) 실천하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person whose job is to examine and treat people's teeth"

det.korean: patient=환자 / teacher=교사 / student=학생 / dentist=치과의사
det.analysis:
① patient: 환자 — 치료를 받는 사람
② teacher: 교사 — 가르치는 사람
③ student: 학생 — 배우는 사람
④ dentist: 치과의사 — 사람의 치아를 진찰하고 치료하는 것이 직업인 사람 ←정답
det.tip: examine and treat people's teeth(치아를 진찰·치료) → dentist(치과의사)

questions.passage: The goal of his visit was to improve the students' __________ (understand) of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: understand(동사: 이해하다) → understanding(명사: 이해). 소유격 the students' 뒤 명사 자리
det.analysis: understand를 명사 understanding으로 변환. 'the students' __________ of ~'에서 소유격(the students') 뒤와 전치사 of 앞은 명사 자리예요. 그래서 이해(understanding)라는 명사가 필요해요.
det.tip: 소유격 뒤 + of 앞 = 명사 자리 → understanding

questions.passage: Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. __________ (Encourage) by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: encourage(동사: 격려하다) → Encouraged(과거분사). 분사구문에서 주어가 '격려를 받는' 수동 관계
det.analysis: encourage를 과거분사 Encouraged로 변환해요. 문장 맨 앞에서 콤마로 이어지는 분사구문인데, 주어(they, 학생들)가 스스로 격려하는 게 아니라 치과의사에게 '격려를 받는' 수동 관계라서 과거분사(p.p.)를 써요. 'Encouraged by ~' = '~에 의해 격려받아서'.
det.tip: 주어가 '~받는' 수동 관계 → 과거분사 Encouraged (분사구문)

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner a number of questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They __________ playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: gave up=포기했다 / broke down=고장 났다 / showed off=자랑했다 / took turns=교대로 했다
det.analysis:
① gave up: 역할을 '포기'했다? 마스크·장갑까지 끼며 활동한 것과 안 맞음
② broke down: 고장 났다 — 사람에게 부적절
③ showed off: 자랑했다 — 문맥 부적절
④ took turns: 학생들이 '교대로' 치과의사 역할을 맡음 ←정답
det.tip: 여러 학생이 돌아가며 역할을 맡음 = took turns(교대로 하다)

questions.passage: Earlier this week, our students welcomed Dr. Turner, a local dentist from the Randolph Dental Clinic nearby. The goal of his visit was to improve the students' understanding of the importance of dental health. They were extremely interested and asked Dr. Turner __________ questions. After the question-and-answer session, the students participated in a role-playing activity. They took turns playing the role of a dentist, even putting on a mask and gloves. Having completed the experience, each student received a gift bag filled with useful items for keeping their teeth clean and healthy. Encouraged by the visiting dentist to practice proper dental care at home, they are all likely to take better care of their teeth than ever before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a lack of=~의 부족 / a piece of=한 조각의 / a number of=많은, 다수의 / a bit of=약간의
det.analysis:
① a lack of: 질문의 '부족'? 매우 관심 있어 했다는 흐름과 반대
② a piece of: 한 조각의 질문? 어색함
③ a number of: 매우 관심 있어 해서 '많은' 질문을 함 ←정답
④ a bit of: 약간의 질문? 관심이 컸다는 흐름과 안 맞음
det.tip: 매우 흥미로워 했으므로 많은(a number of) 질문을 함
